title: Weighted subset sum
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\delta$, and a real-valued function $g$ on subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define its weighted sum to be $\sum_{J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}g(J)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
